difficulty_why: Linear allows any standard workspace account to create a public OAuth application with immediate external distribution and no mandatory review or install caps.

dev_time.label: 10-15 min
dev_time.text: Time to sign in, create a public OAuth application in Linear workspace settings, configure the redirect URI, and copy client credentials.

launch_time.label: Same day
launch_time.text: Public OAuth apps can be authorized by external users immediately upon registration without waiting for approval, provided the app is configured with public distribution.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Show your own application name, developer name, and icon on Linear's OAuth authorization consent screen instead of Composio's branding.

own_app_reasons.label: Granular runtime scope control
own_app_reasons.text: Request customized or narrower OAuth scopes specific to your AI agent workflows beyond Composio defaults.

app_type.label: Public OAuth 2.0 Application
app_type.text: Create an OAuth 2.0 application with public distribution. Public distribution allows users outside your workspace to authorize and install the integration.

prerequisites.label: Linear account and workspace
prerequisites.text: An active Linear account and workspace. Linear recommends creating a dedicated workspace to manage your OAuth app.

prerequisites.label: Workspace admin permissions
prerequisites.text: Admin privileges in your Linear workspace to create applications under API settings.

prerequisites.label: Application homepage URL
prerequisites.text: A public HTTP or HTTPS URL for your application homepage or documentation.

prerequisites.label: Developer name
prerequisites.text: A developer or organization name between 2 and 80 characters.

prerequisites.label: Free plan with API access
prerequisites.text: API and OAuth application management are available on Linear's free tier with no paid subscription or credit card required.

steps.label: Navigate to API Applications settings
steps.text: Sign in to your Linear workspace and navigate to Settings > API > Applications, or visit https://linear.app/settings/api/applications/new directly.

steps.label: Enter application details and set public distribution
steps.text: Fill in your application name, developer name, and homepage URL. Set Distribution to Public so external Linear workspaces can install and authorize the app. Do not include 'Linear' in the name.

steps.label: Configure callback URL
steps.text: Enter the Composio redirect URI in the Callback URLs field.

steps.label: Save and obtain client credentials
steps.text: Create the application and record the generated Client ID and Client Secret for use in your Composio connection configuration.

steps.label: Pass requested scopes at authorization time
steps.text: Linear does not define scopes in the developer console; ensure the authorization URL includes the required comma-separated scopes when redirecting users to https://linear.app/oauth/authorize.

scopes.label: read
scopes.text: Grants read access to user data and workspace resources; does not trigger platform review.

scopes.label: write
scopes.text: Grants write access to modify workspace entities; does not trigger platform review.

scopes.label: issues:create
scopes.text: Allows creating and modifying issues and attachments; does not trigger platform review.

scopes.label: comments:create
scopes.text: Allows posting and updating issue comments; does not trigger platform review.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Review is only required if you want your application listed in Linear's public Integration Directory; unreviewed OAuth apps can be distributed and installed across any Linear workspace without prior approval.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: Linear sets no install cap or user limit on unreviewed public OAuth applications.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Unreviewed apps receive standard OAuth rate limits of 5,000 requests and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour per user.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Unreviewed OAuth apps operate with full production capabilities, standard 24-hour access tokens, and the standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: For directory listing, Linear verifies that the app is built by a formal company, provides community utility, and supplies 320x320 icons and 1600x1000 showcase images.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Linear charges no fee to register, use, or submit an OAuth application to the Integration Directory.

pitfalls.label: Private distribution default
pitfalls.text: New applications default to private distribution, which prevents external workspaces from authorizing the app until set to public.

pitfalls.label: Name restrictions
pitfalls.text: The app name cannot contain the word 'Linear' or URL protocols like 'http://' or 'https://'.

pitfalls.label: Scopes not defined in console
pitfalls.text: Linear does not configure scopes during app registration; scopes must be passed dynamically in the authorize URL query parameter.

pitfalls.label: Token expiration and refresh
pitfalls.text: Linear access tokens expire after 24 hours, requiring storage and handling of refresh tokens.

pitfalls.label: Query complexity limit
pitfalls.text: Linear rejects GraphQL queries with calculated complexity exceeding 10,000 points immediately, regardless of remaining hourly quota.

pitfalls.label: Customer workspace app approvals
pitfalls.text: Customer workspaces with third-party app approvals enabled require workspace admin approval before regular members can authorize the app.

support.label: Linear Slack community
support.text: Join Linear's official community Slack and ask API questions in the #api and #api-agents channels.

support.label: Linear developer support email
support.text: Contact support@linear.app for bug reports, unexpected API errors, and technical questions.

support.label: Integrations team email
support.text: Email integrations@linear.app for questions regarding public Integration Directory listings.

email_subject: OAuth 2.0 application distribution and review inquiry - [Your App Name]
email_body:
Hi Linear Developer Support team,

We are developing an AI agent integration that connects users to their Linear accounts via OAuth 2.0 to manage issues and comments.

Could you confirm:
1. Whether any scopes (specifically read, write, issues:create, comments:create) require formal review or verification before multi-tenant distribution.
2. If there are any unlisted installation limits or tenant caps for unreviewed public OAuth applications.
3. The current review timeline and submission requirements if we choose to submit our app for listing in the Linear Integration Directory.

Application details:
- App Name: [Your App Name]
- Workspace URL: [Your Linear Workspace URL]
- Client ID: [Your Client ID]

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Your Role / Company]
